# Template: cost_effectiveness_plane
Incremental cost (y) vs incremental effect (x) plane with four quadrant guide captions, up to 6 intervention points, and optional threshold lines through the origin (a WTP line, or several labelled ones with a shaded band between two). Choose this for ANY request about a cost-effectiveness plane, an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) comparison, or plotting interventions by cost and effect. The domain and both axes are computed for you; you only choose the points and lines. Default captions follow the cast's language.
Parameter schema:

   "type": "string",
   "description": "Default \"Incremental effect (QALYs)\"."
  },

   "type": "string",
   "description": "Default \"Incremental cost\"; put the unit here."
  },

   ],
   "description": "\"first\": only the north-east quadrant, axes bottom-left. Default \"full\"."
  },
  "x_max": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Axis end; default fitted to the points."

  "y_max": {
   "type": "number"
  },

   "description": "Numbers on the axes. Default: on in view first."
  },
  "wtp_threshold": {

    },

 ]
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- x_axis: the horizontal (effect) axis with its caption
- y_axis: the vertical (cost) axis with its caption
- wtp_line: the dashed WTP line — present only when wtp_threshold is set
- wtp_label: its caption
- threshold_line_<n> / label_threshold_<n>: thresholds[n-1]'s line and caption
- threshold_band: the band
- q_ne / q_nw / q_se / q_sw: the quadrant captions
- pt_<i>: intervention point i (0-indexed, in `points` order)
- pt_label_<i>: point i's label caption
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Show two treatments on a cost-effectiveness plane with a WTP threshold of 30,000 per QALY." → params: {"title":"Two treatments vs. standard care","wtp_threshold":30000,"points":[{"label":"New drug","effect":0.4,"cost":8000,"emphasize":true},{"label":"Surgery","effect":0.7,"cost":32000}]}
Request: "Plot a dominant intervention that costs less and works better than the alternative on a cost-effectiveness plane." → params: {"title":"A dominant intervention","points":[{"label":"New protocol","effect":1.2,"cost":-4000,"emphasize":true},{"label":"Standard care","effect":0,"cost":0}]}
Request: "Ny behandling: 0,5 QALY for 200 000 kr, mot grensene 275 000–825 000 kr per QALY." → params: {"view":"first","y_label":"Merkostnad (1000 kr)","y_max":500,"thresholds":[{"value":275,"label":"275 000"},{"value":825,"label":"Alvorlig: 825 000"}],"band":[1,2],"points":[{"label":"Ny behandling","effect":0.5,"cost":200}]}

In YAML: `template: cost_effectiveness_plane` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
